name: @stryketrade/reference-bot
description: Runnable reference bot built exclusively on the public Stryke SDK.

scripts.prepack: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build
scripts.start:read-only: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node dist/cli.js --read-only
scripts.start:live-data: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node dist/cli.js --live-data
scripts.start:paper: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/cli.js --profile=paper
scripts.start:devnet: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/cli.js --profile=devnet
scripts.start:live: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/cli.js --profile=live
scripts.doctor:paper: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node dist/cli.js doctor --profile=paper
scripts.doctor:live: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env dist/cli.js doctor --profile=live
scripts.test:polymarket-fixture: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node dist/cli.js --fixture-polymarket
scripts.test:polymarket-bootstrap-fixture: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node dist/cli.js --fixture-polymarket-bootstrap
scripts.test:polymarket-late-fixture: npm run build -w @stryketrade/sdk && npm run build && node dist/cli.js --fixture-polymarket-late
